_note: Configuration for scripts/validate_skill.py. Shipped by the blueprint bundle, not written by a build step. Every files.max_lines value is a ceiling; every counted_at_authoring value was counted from the file on 2026-10-21.
_expected_name_note: The frontmatter name is compared against this value, not against the directory name, so a fixture tree under scripts/tests/fixtures/<rule>/ does not fail the frontmatter rule merely for living in a differently named directory.

encoding._crlf_note: The committed blobs are CRLF (upstream state; core.autocrlf=true locally). Normalising them would edit SKILL.md and README.md, which this change may not touch, so the rule normalises CRLF for analysis instead of failing on it.
